name: pr-review
description: Multi-persona PR review pipeline. Clones the PR into an isolated per-instance workspace (never a local ~/Repos checkout), runs Architect R1 -> 10x R1 -> Architect R2 -> 10x R2 -> Security, verifies every required persona actually posted (fail-loud on dropout), then Manager decides. Optionally a senior engineer auto-implements the selected fix tier; a verify-fix gate (build/tests + wired-and-fed provenance check) pushes to the PR branch only if the fixes are clean, else reports BLOCKED. Reviewers run a mandatory wired-and-fed provenance trace, not just a diff read.
author: arbitron

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: GitHub repo in owner/name format (e.g. dbinky/arbitron). Cloned fresh (shallow) from the remote into an isolated per-instance workspace; no local ~/Repos checkout is used.

inputs.name: fix_scope
inputs.description: Auto-implement tier. One of: must, must-should, all-but-defer, none. 'none' skips the senior-engineer node entirely.

nodes.label: Init PR workspace
nodes.description: Shallow-clone {{repo}} from the remote into {{workspace}}/work and check out PR #{{pr_number}}; emit {work_dir, pr_branch, pr_head, base}. No ~/Repos is used.

nodes.label: Promote vars
nodes.description: Lift init-pr-workspace outputs (work_dir, pr_branch, pr_head, base) to top-level vars for the persona templates and commit-push.

nodes.label: Architect R1
nodes.description: Ivory Tower Architect first pass; posts inline + general comments; traces provenance/wiring of new structural pieces

nodes.label: 10x R1
nodes.description: 10x GSD Engineer first pass; runs the wired-and-fed provenance trace, replies to architect threads, adds practical findings

nodes.label: Architect R2
nodes.description: Architect second pass; concedes or doubles down in existing threads only

nodes.label: 10x R2
nodes.description: 10x second pass; final positions in existing threads

nodes.label: Security
nodes.description: Security expert; weighs in on existing debates and posts severity-tagged findings

nodes.label: Verify personas posted
nodes.description: Deterministic fail-loud gate: count comments per required persona prefix (architect/10x/security); abort the run if any posted nothing, so the manager never synthesizes a partial panel.

nodes.label: Manager
nodes.description: Engineering manager; per-thread decisions + Decision Summary with verdict

nodes.label: Senior Engineer
nodes.description: Implements the selected fix tier in the isolated worktree and commits (wired-and-fed, no self-certified half-fixes); the verify-fix gate decides whether to push

nodes.label: Verify fix (wired-and-fed gate)
nodes.description: Runs build/tests + a wired-and-fed provenance check on the senior engineer's unpushed commits; emits {push_ok, blockers, notes}. Catches half-wired Musts and new regressions before they ship.

nodes.label: Fixes clean?
nodes.description: Push the fixes only if verify-fix passed; otherwise route to fix-blocked (no push).

nodes.label: Commit & push fixes
nodes.description: Commit any uncommitted senior-engineer fixes and push to the PR branch on the remote. Reached only when verify-fix passed.

nodes.label: Fix blocked (not pushed)
nodes.description: Reached when verify-fix failed: post a BLOCKED comment with the blockers and do NOT push; commits stay in the unpushed worktree.

nodes.label: Skipped (review-only)
nodes.description: No-op terminal node reached when fix_scope == 'none'
